Name: Skell's Wings - Fashion Sense
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=5]Information:[/size]

This mod adds 4 different wing styles in many colors using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]'s framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].

To use the wings, you need to buy the Hand Mirror Tool from Pierre.
 [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/877655710991810610/908315195309436978/hand.PNG[/img]
Click to open the Hand Mirror menu, and select the accessories tab as shown in the picture below, and pick out the style you want using the arrows!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/877655710991810610/908315195359784970/er.PNG[/img]

For more information on the Hand Mirror Tool, check the wiki [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]here[/url]. ﻿

[size=5]Installation: [/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy! [size=4] [/size]

[size=5]Credits and Extra Information:
[/size]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url] for the wonderful framework! <3
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106750543]Billi[/url] for the beautiful screenshots!! <3 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643]CopperSun[/url], nothing to do with the mod, she's just wonderful
- Recommended to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10046]Bits 'n' Bobs[/url] for extra cute stuff!
